intro.text: A darkeyed Alethi woman who helped her father, a quartermaster in Amaram's army, and once had a relationship with Kaladin there.

items.text: Tarah helped her father, an assistant quartermaster in Meridas Amaram's army, outfitting new recruits. She met Kaladin once he had begun making a name as a squad leader, and told him which young recruits needed his protection.

She and Kaladin were together for a time and she urged him to ease off the grief-driven spear training that she said would burn him out, hoping he would learn to be there for the living, not just the dead.

Offered a scribe's post at Mourn's Vault, Tarah took it, partly so her father could join her there instead of being sent to the Shattered Plains. She wrote to Kaladin twice after leaving, but he never wrote back.

appearance.text: Slightly plump, with black hair, a round face and smooth hands. She favours old-fashioned Thaylen dresses, usually with a brightly coloured shirt, and Kaladin remembers her smelling of starched uniforms and new leather.

personality.text: Distrustful of anything she hasn't requisitioned herself, she knows how to stretch her spheres, knows weapons well and is at ease with the attentions of young men.
